newsitem.title: USA: Wis. Electric sees 605 MW unit up Oct 6.
newsitem.headline: Wis. Electric sees 605 MW unit up Oct 6.

text.p: Wisconsin Electric Power Co's 605 megawatt Pleasant Prairie coal-fired power unit 2 is expected to resume production October 6 from scheduled maintenance which began September 13, a company spokesman said.
"This is our annual outage, we expect to be down about three weeks," said spokesman James Vallee.
The Pleasant Prairie unit 1, also with a capacity of 605 megawatts, was operating at 100 percent of capacity during the unit 2 outage, the spokesman said.
The Pleasant Prairie plant is located at Kenosha, Wis.
Wisconson Electric is a subsidiary of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
